cards.card_text: God lists the garments: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban and a sash.
cards.verse_text: These are the garments that they shall make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban, and a sash.
cards.snippet: …that they shall make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban, and a sash.

cards.card_text: Aaron gets a fine linen tunic, a fine linen turban and an embroidered sash, and his sons get tunics, sashes and headbands.
cards.verse_text: You are to weave the tunic with fine linen, make the turban of fine linen, and fashion an embroidered sash.

cards.card_text: Next, Moses is to dress Aaron in the garments, from the tunic to the turban with its holy diadem, and anoint him by pouring oil on his head.
cards.verse_text: Take the garments and clothe Aaron with the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod itself, and the breastplate.
cards.snippet: Take the garments and clothe Aaron with the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod itself, and the breastplate.

cards.card_text: Then come the linen pieces: tunics, a turban, ornate headbands, undergarments and a sash embroidered with blue, purple and scarlet yarn.
cards.verse_text: For Aaron and his sons they made tunics of fine linen, the work of a weaver, as well as the turban of fine linen, the ornate headbands and undergarments of finely spun linen, and the sash of finely spun linen, embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

cards.card_text: Then Saul dresses David in his own tunic, a bronze helmet and armor.
cards.verse_text: David added, “The LORD, who delivered me from the claws of the lion and the bear, will deliver me from the hand of this Philistine.” “Go,” said Saul, “and may the LORD be with you.” Then Saul clothed David in his own tunic, put a bronze helmet on his head, and dressed him in armor.
cards.snippet: …the LORD be with you.” Then Saul clothed David in his own tunic, put a bronze helmet on his head, and dressed him in armor.
